in_marathi.name: Devbrat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devbrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devbrat is a compound name made up of two Sanskrit words – ‘Dev’ meaning God and ‘Brat’ meaning son. This name is often given to a child born in a devout Hindu family, signifying the child as a divine gift.
